hook.name: DoubleSineHook
hook.description: Custom AMM hook managing two pools (ETH/TokenA and ETH/TokenB) sharing a single virtual ETH reserve via a proprietary constant-product curve (DoubleSineMath). The hook fully intercepts all swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, bypassing Uniswap's native pricing. Charges a 1% buy/sell fee directed to an immutable treasury. Liquidity addition/removal is disabled; buy size is capped for the first 5 blocks post-initialization as an anti-snipe measure.
